children: Bedrock ends all cross-chain support for $BR on Berachain, Base, and Solana on December 2, 2026. Bridging between Ethereum Mainnet and BNB Chain remains active through Chainlink CCIP.

Holders on the three affected chains need to move their $BR back to BNB Chain before the deadline. The change concentrates $BR on fewer chains and could add selling pressure. Bedrock says the affected routes saw little use, which limits the overall effect.
• Grace Period: 15 days from today (closing Dec 2, 2026)
• Once the 15-day grace period ends, no cross-chain activity for
on Berachain, Base, or Solana will be supported or entertained.

title: Bedrock: $BR Cross-Chain Support Ends on Berachain, Base, and Solana - 02 Dec 2026
